runbooks.diagnosis: OpenCloud 6.0.0 had a startup data race with default GOMAXPROCS on multi-core hosts; the fix in this stack is GOMAXPROCS=1 for the startup phase. If the env var was dropped in an image bump, the race returns.
remediation: Verify GOMAXPROCS=1 is set in the opencloud service environment
Check the oc_notifications/oc_* SMTP env names have the OC_ prefix where required
Restart opencloud after the env fix

runbooks.diagnosis: The S3/Garage backend env (endpoint, bucket, credentials) is misconfigured. In this stack opencloud may use the built-in ocis (local FS) backend instead — a mixed config (some services on S3, some local) surfaces as missing files after a restart.
remediation: Confirm which storage backend the current config selects (OC_* storage env)
If S3: verify bucket exists and credentials work from inside the container
Do NOT switch backends on a populated instance without a migration

runbooks.diagnosis: OpenCloud's OIDC issuer URL must be the externally reachable IdM URL, not the internal service name — token validation happens against the issuer metadata.
remediation: Set the OIDC issuer to the public IdM URL
Ensure opencloud can reach that URL from inside the compose network (hairpin NAT or split DNS)
